$comment: One contract for every component an Oto tool call renders.
The rules are deliberately few and all of them are things that were
fills_panel    — the card fills the fixed canvas panel, so the panel
stops re-centring on every swap. Was 241-549px.
has_title      — the card says what it is. RatingsCard did not.
has_icon       — service catalog, pricing and tires had lost theirs.
title_size     — 19px everywhere; the receipt had drifted to 22px.
no_silent_clip — anything scrolled out of view fades at the cut, so
hidden content reads as hidden. Service Catalog hid a
whole category behind an invisible fold.
holds_selection— the canvas still shows what it was told to show after
the connect-timeout window. Regression test for the
fallback that used to overwrite an explicit choice.
debug-triggers.tsx). Adding a card there is what puts it under test.

cards.why: Deliberate exception: the terminal celebration, with a centred check mark and a larger title, rather than another explainer. Declared here so the difference stays a decision instead of becoming drift. This card is also slated for replacement — nothing can actually be booked from the website.
